en.bilal-muhammad: Hamza b. Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Zayd b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim informed me in 307 AH. He said: My father narrated to me from Ali b. Mu`abbad from al-Husayn b. Khalid from `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
O `Ali! You are my brother, my vizier, and my standard bearer in this world and the Hereafter. You are the master of my Pond. Whoever loves you has loved me, and whoever hates you has hated me.
